mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_project (code, name, type, location, client_name, supervisor_unit, project_manager_id, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{location}, #{clientName}, #{supervisorUnit}, #{projectManagerId}, #{plannedStartDate}, #{plannedEndDate}, #{actualStartDate}, #{actualEndDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, type, location, client_name, supervisor_unit, project_manager_id, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_project WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, code, name, type, location, client_name, supervisor_unit, project_manager_id, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_project WHERE code = #{code} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT code FROM t_project WHERE code LIKE CONCAT('PRJ-', #{year}, '-%') ORDER BY code DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_project SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, location = #{location}, client_name = #{clientName}, supervisor_unit = #{supervisorUnit}, project_manager_id = #{projectManagerId}, planned_start_date = #{plannedStartDate}, planned_end_date = #{plannedEndDate}, actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate}, actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_project SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit AS material_unit, SUM(pr.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(po.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM t_purchase_request pr JOIN t_purchase_order po ON pr.id = po.purchase_request_id JOIN t_material m ON pr.material_id = m.id WHERE pr.project_id = #{projectId} AND po.status = 2 AND pr.is_deleted = 0 AND po.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.spec, m.unit ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT id, code, name, type, location, client_name, supervisor_unit, project_manager_id, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_project WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, code, name, type, location, client_name, supervisor_unit, project_manager_id, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_project WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
